summary: Comprehensive backend (29 pytest tests) + frontend (admin, officer, citizen, map, notifications) testing of Smart City app. 28/29 backend tests pass (96.5%). All major frontend flows render and integrate correctly. AI classification preview and report creation via API work. The only backend failure is a seed/spec mismatch (9 unique departments vs spec's 10) and a few minor frontend findings.

minor.issue: Seed creates only 9 unique departments (DEFAULT_ROUTING.values() dedupes to 9). Spec/PRD requests 10. Either update spec text or extend DEFAULT_ROUTING/seed to produce 10 distinct departments.

WS connections are immediately closed via the preview ingress ('WebSocket is closed before the connection is established'). Real-time updates therefore not delivered to clients in preview environment. Likely ingress proxy_pass for /api/ws is not configured for upgrade, or backend disconnects when client doesn't send messages. Verify ingress WS support or use SSE fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking on a queue row (outside the title link) does not navigate to /reports/{id}. Only the title <Link> is clickable. Consider making the whole row clickable for better UX.

No explicit lat/lng inputs are exposed; lat/lng is only set via map click or 'Use my location' (browser geolocation). In headless/desktop without permission, the form can be filled with all fields and submit is enabled but submission silently fails (no toast/error visible). Add a visible numeric lat/lng input fallback or block submit until coords set with a clear error.

integration_issues.issue: All pages attempt WS connection; the connection is rejected by ingress. App still works (REST falls back), but realtime events (new report broadcast, status update, notifications) won't reach the browser.

action_items: Either reword PRD ('9 departments') or extend DEFAULT_ROUTING (in /app/backend/ai_service.py) so seed produces 10 unique departments.
Investigate WebSocket failure via the k8s/nginx ingress (wss://.../api/ws closes immediately). Confirm upgrade headers are forwarded; otherwise document that realtime updates rely on polling.
SubmitReport: expose visible lat/lng inputs OR disable submit button until lat/lng set and show a clear error toast when geolocation is denied / coords missing.
OfficerDashboard: make full queue row clickable to navigate to /reports/{id} (minor UX).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~930 lines — consider splitting routes into modules (auth, reports, analytics, uploads, admin).
Seed runs only when users collection is empty (good). Idempotent. Passwords hashed with bcrypt. JWT uses HS256.
create_report awaits AI classification on every POST — if Gemini is slow this blocks the request; consider returning quickly with status=Submitted and classifying in background.
count_nearby_duplicates and /reports/check-duplicate iterate all open reports in Python — fine at current scale but should use a geo index ($near) for production.
GET /api/files/{path}?auth={token} accepts JWT in query string — token will be logged by proxies/CDN. Acceptable for short-lived URLs but consider signed URLs.
Frontend uses `process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` everywhere — good. data-testid coverage is solid.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all major flows render; minor UX gaps and WS not testable)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@smartcity.gov / Admin@12345; Officer: officer1@smartcity.gov / Officer@123; Citizen: citizen@smartcity.gov / Citizen@123
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded by backend on first start. Pytest also created a few TEST_ reports/comments via citizen account (not cleaned up; safe to leave).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_smartcity.py covers auth, departments, routing, reports CRUD, AI preview, duplicates, upvote, comments, status update RBAC, uploads (JPEG via Pillow), analytics, notifications. The /api/ws WebSocket endpoint accepts ?token= but ingress closes connection immediately — likely environment/ingress config issue, not application bug. Citizen submit UI flow can't be fully tested without geolocation; verify via direct POST /api/reports (already covered). Frontend route paths: /citizen, /citizen/submit, /citizen/map, /officer, /officer/map, /admin, /admin/{departments,officers,routing,map}, /reports/:id. CityMap renders Leaflet CircleMarkers (SVG circles), NOT default marker icons — don't use .leaflet-marker-icon selector.
rca of the issue: Departments count: ai_service.DEFAULT_ROUTING has 11 categories mapping to only 9 unique department names. Seed deduplicates via `set(DEFAULT_ROUTING.values())` → 9 docs. Fix: add 1-2 more unique department names in DEFAULT_ROUTING (e.g., split 'Public Works Department' into 'Roads Department' for Road Damage) OR explicitly seed 10 departments and link categories. WebSocket: app code is correct (token query auth, accept, broadcast). The wss handshake fails at ingress layer; backend likely never sees it. Need to verify ingress allows Upgrade: websocket on /api/ws path.
